name: Ford Credit (Ford Motor Credit Company)
notes: Researched from public ford.com/finance pages only (no sign-in). Account Manager and the Ford Credit app sign in with a Ford account (email-based; marked inferred). Guest Pay lets anyone make a one-time payment without signing in; payments before 9 p.m. ET post the same business day. Automatic payments debit the invoiced amount on the due date (no other amount can be chosen) from a bank account; changes must be made by 9 p.m. ET at least two business days before the due date. Card payments are not described, so methods are bank-only (inferred). The hardship page only offers a phone call (800-727-7000), so payment_arrangement is unsupported online. Paperless is a toggle under Notification Settings. Combined billing and payroll deduction exist but are not modelled.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Sign in to Account Manager or the Ford Credit app to make a single payment or turn on Automatic Payments. Without an account, use Guest Pay any time for a one-time payment; payments made before 9 p.m. ET post the same business day.
You can also schedule a payment or make a next-day payment by phone, mail a check with your invoice to the address printed on it, or send a wire through MoneyGram or Western Union.

help.title: Automatic Payments
paragraphs: Automatic payments debit your invoiced amount from your bank account on your due date (the next business day if it falls on a weekend or holiday). You cannot choose a different amount; use a principal-only or custom payment for extra.

In Account Manager, choose Turn On next to Automatic payments off, pick the bank account and select Agree and Turn On. To stop, choose Manage, then Turn Off Automatic Payments. Make changes by 9 p.m. ET at least two business days before your due date.
steps: Choose Turn On next to Automatic payments off.
Choose or add a bank account.

help.title: If you cannot pay your bill
paragraphs: Call Ford Credit at 800-727-7000 to talk about account-specific options. A late charge may apply if payment arrives after the period in your contract, interest keeps accruing, and past-due accounts may be reported to the credit bureaus at 30, 60 and 90 days.

help.title: Paperless statements
paragraphs: In Account Manager, open Notification Settings, switch Paperless Statements on or off and select Save Changes. In the app it is under Settings. Statements are issued about 17 to 20 days before your next due date.

extra.intent: Using the Ford Credit help pages, find how far ahead of your due date you must make changes to Automatic Payments. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: Changes must be made by 9 p.m. ET at least two business days before the due date.
